lines.zh: 气焰拖到身后，像烧起来的长发。
lines.en: My aura trails behind like burning long hair.

lines.zh: 个子小，气势把周围的树压弯。
lines.en: Small in body, but I bow the trees around me.

lines.zh: 每一步都让空气发出低鸣。
lines.en: Each step makes the air hum low.

lines.zh: 我没长高，头发却长到膝盖。
lines.en: I did not grow taller, but my hair reaches my knees.
Lightning and flame circle me together.

lines.zh: 我走过石地，石头裂成细纹。
lines.en: I cross stone and it cracks into fine lines.

lines.zh: 手腕上还留着战斗的痕。
lines.en: Battle marks remain on my wrists.
My cape stands out like a banner.
I lift my foot, and the ground reacts late.
The wind goes around me.
I step forward and my ki lays the grass down.
The road is long; I do not care.

lines.zh: 我站着，气焰几乎没有边界。
lines.en: I stand; my aura has almost no edge.

lines.zh: 长发垂到膝上，末端在烧。
lines.en: My long hair hangs to my knees, burning at the tips.
A flick of my finger scatters sparks.
This body is still small.
But the ki is enough.
I squint at the sky.
Thunder bursts behind my shoulder.
I do not look back.
The ground hums beneath me.
I clench my fist to its limit.

lines.zh: 气焰收着，长发拖到膝弯。
lines.en: My aura is banked; long hair hangs to my knees.
My ki keeps rising.
I exhale slowly.
A little flame escapes my mouth.
I look up, fire in my pupils.

lines.zh: 你现在站的地方很危险。
lines.en: The ground you stand on is dangerous now.
I smile; my teeth are very white.

lines.zh: 气流把你的衣服吹得乱响。
lines.en: My aura snaps at your clothes.
You cannot even steady your ki.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，雷丝在指间跳。
lines.en: I raise a hand, lightning jumping between my fingers.
Flame balls in my palm.
Then I snuff it out.
No hurry.
I want to look at you first.
I step back half a pace.
You strike first; I will not take the advantage.
Grinning through my teeth, ki already full.

lines.zh: 风把我的长发吹到前面。
lines.en: Wind blows my long hair forward.
I sweep it aside.
Come.
I grit my teeth; my aura bursts.
Half a step back.
My arcs scatter.
This is nothing.
I smooth the ki around my neck.
I lick the blood from my lip.
That punch has some weight; I'll give you that.

lines.zh: 变小了，超级赛亚人3还是满的。
lines.en: Shrunken, but Super Saiyan 3 is still full.
I do not want to eat now.
My flame burns it.
One glance and I move on.
Leave these for someone else.
Smaller now — my presence isn't.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的胃现在不重要。
lines.en: A Saiyan's stomach does not matter now.
Step back.
Do not stall me with this.

lines.zh: 迷你个子，第三阶的力量。
lines.en: Mini body, third-form power.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，气浪把你推开。
lines.en: You hit me and the shockwave throws you back.
I barely notice.
A flame brushes your sleeve.
I turn aside.
Do not come near my aura.
I push you to one side.
The ground craters under my step.
You back off.
Go further.
This is not for now.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的伴侣，得先接住我三招。
lines.en: A Saiyan's mate must first take three of my blows.
I still have accounts to settle.
I press the thought down.
Fire rolls in my chest.
The rest can wait.

lines.zh: 找个能接住我拳头的人，难。
lines.en: Someone who can take my punch is hard to find.
Do not follow.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，火把它烧了一角。
lines.en: I pick it up; fire chars a corner.
It is ruined.
This will do.
I stow it in my cape.
It crushes at a touch.
I wipe it clean.
Do not block.

lines.zh: 放我下来，赛亚人的尊严不是玩具。
lines.en: Put me down — a Saiyan's pride is no toy.
I raise my head; my ki pushes the clouds apart.
Found you. Don't try to slip away.
Thunder bursts at my feet.
Flame ignites on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 气聚到腿上，我准备好了。
lines.en: Ki gathers in my legs; I'm ready.
Cracks open below me.

lines.zh: 你的破绽我一眼就看穿。
lines.en: I see your opening at a glance.
No need to drag it out.
No holding back this time.
Small body. Not a small power level.

lines.zh: 残影还留在原地，人已经到你背后。
lines.en: My afterimage stays put; I'm already behind you.
Thunder moves first; I arrive after.
You will remember this.
Mini sized. Third stage aura.
I am at its face in an instant.
An afterimage still burns where I was.
The blows do not stop.

lines.zh: 它挡了第一下，第二下落了。
lines.en: It blocks the first; the second lands.
Flame sheathes my fist.
Lightning lashes from the side.
It retreats; I press harder.
Lightning burns a line along the ground.
Its ki is nearly gone.
Too slow.
I gather all my ki.
This blow will be remembered.
The air grows hot.

lines.zh: 终极闪光的白光在我掌心聚。
lines.en: The white of Final Flash gathers in my palm.
Lightning and flame arrive together.
I land.

lines.zh: 这一发加利克炮，够结束你。
lines.en: One Gallick Gun is enough to finish you.
My fist falls and the ground breaks into blocks.
Strikes with flame burn through armor.
I follow and strike upward.
I stand at the rim and watch.
It still tries to move.
I press a palm down.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的手臂流进去。
lines.en: Flame runs down my arm into it.
My knee knocks its hand aside.
The guard splits.
I shove it away.
My aura still burns.
My ki punches a hole in the clouds.
I drop through it.
My long hair hangs to my knees.
Thunder bursts where I land.
I raise a hand and look.
The ki is so full it nearly spills.
This body actually held.
The grass around is charred.
The wind goes around.

lines.zh: 我从天而降，气把云推开。
lines.en: I drop from the sky, aura shoving the clouds apart.

lines.zh: 脚一落地，四周的树都弯了。
lines.en: The moment I land, the trees around bend.
The ground splits.
I bare my teeth in a grin.
Smaller frame, no less ki.
Thunder follows.
Fire wraps me; I draw it aside.
I hit the ground and thunder bursts with me.
Water presses in; I boil it away.
The blast shoves me back some blocks.
An arrow grazes my face.
Hungry, and my ki thins.
Lightning strikes me and I laugh.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我烧着往上冲。
lines.en: Nothing below; I burn my way upward.
